caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser shown from two perspectives: the left side view and the front view. The dresser is made of brown wood with visible wood grain patterns throughout its surfaces. The front view displays three horizontal drawers, each with two round metal drawer pulls. The top part of the dresser features a horizontal ledge, and the corners have vertical supports that extend above and below the drawers. The side view shows the rectangular shape of the dresser with a panel inset and a curved, scroll-like detail at the bottom of the side support. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are no additional decorative elements or objects in the drawing.
title: Dresser
